title: Senate Confirms Jay Clayton to Lead U.S. Intelligence Community
summary: Mr. Clayton, who shed Democratic support after he refused to clearly say Joseph R. Biden Jr. won the 2020 election, will take over the Office of the Director of National Intelligence from Bill Pulte.
